glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 金 (“metal”) + phonetic 𢧤. The original version, according to the Shuowen Jiezi, is 𨮯, with 大 on top, hence the original phonetic component should be not 𢧜.
shuowen: The original version, according to the Shuowen Jiezi, is 𨮯, with 大 on top, hence the original phonetic component should be not 𢧜.
senses: [tiě] (only in compounds) short for 鐵路 (“railway”)
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 鐵; s_page_origin explains the simplified 铁.
